newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on share movement limit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on share movement limit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are seen falling in thin trade following the imposition of a limit on share price movement by the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE), brokers said.
"I think there will be thin trading becasue the investors are expected to trade cautiously after the DSE's move to prevent wild fluctuation of share prices," said broker Mahbub Morshed.

The DSE has limited share price movement within 10 percent of the previous day's rate, effective Saturday. The DSE all-share price index closed 43.20 points or 2.08 percent down at 2,024.43 on Thursday.The market was closed on Friday, the Moslem weekend. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
